generation.spoken_text: Catalogues have two overlapping jobs. Database and query-engine catalogues help software find and read data. Hive Metastore describes schemas, partitions such as a day's deliveries, storage locations, and file formats. Discovery and governance catalogues help people understand and manage data. Data Hub and Open Metadata connect technical records with definitions, responsible teams, and lineage. These are main purposes, with overlap: database catalogues can hold comments or ownership too.
